fact: Underline is one property of the whole text element, set by an "Underline" toggle (tooltip "Underline — Ctrl+U") in the properties panel and by Ctrl+U / Cmd+U; the toggle is shown when a text, a shape with text or an arrow with a label is selected, or the Text tool is active, and hidden otherwise.

fact: Ctrl+U / Cmd+U toggles underline when a text, a shape with text or an arrow label is selected or a text is being edited, and then the browser's page source does not open; with nothing or only non-text elements selected it does nothing in the app, and touch devices have no shortcut.

fact: The underline has the text color, its thickness and offset scale with the font size, each line of multi-line or wrapped text has its own underline as wide as that line's text, spaces are underlined and empty lines are not, and it may cross descenders.

fact: With several texts selected and only some underlined, the "Underline" toggle shows a mixed state; one click underlines all of them and a second click removes underline from all; the last chosen underline value is the default for new text.
